OGAT - Update 93 - Hunting Grounds and Jungle Skin Pack Official Release

 Of Guards and Thieves  - Update 93 - Hunting Grounds and Jungle Skin Pack Official Release  
Hi everyone! 
Hunting Grounds and Jungle Skin Pack are now officially available.
For more details open the following links or continue to read below.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1262980/Of_Guards_and_Thieves__Hunting_Grounds/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1262981/Of_Guards_and_Thieves__JUNGLE_Skin_Pack/

 OGAT r.93 changes

FREE DLC "Hunting Grounds" is now officially released
DLC Jungle Skin Pack is now available for purchase
River Village Fix: Removed Cars 
Military Camp: Added Switchable Road Blocks 
Mouse cursor is now locked on a single monitor when game it's played in fullscreen on multi-monitor setup 


 HUNTING GROUNDS 
Of Guards and Thieves - Hunting Grounds is a Free To Play DLC that includes a new set of classes, Sniper for Guards faction and Hunter for Thieves faction, four new weapons, four new gadgets, one new official map called River Village, 10 new unlockable levels and more than 700 new jungle-themed map editor unique objects.

Content List:
New Class: Sniper (Guards)
New Class: Hunter (Thieves)
2 New Avatars: Sniper and Hunter
New unlockable levels (70 to 80)
New Weapon: AVP
New Weapon: Hunting Rifle
New Weapon: Zakarov SD
New Weapon: Hunting Knife
New Weapon: Barbed Wire
New Weapon: Portable Bush
New Weapon: Waps Jar
New Weapon: Chemlight
Map Editor - Diagonal Building Capability
Interactive Vegetation
New Official River Village Map

New Map Editor Content List:
Map Editor NEW Terrain Paintable Textures Set (8 new textures)
Map Editor NEW Terrain Paintable Details Set (5 grass types)
Map Editor NEW Metal Walls Tileset (96 new unique tiles)
Map Editor NEW Metal Wall Passages Tileset (52 new unique tiles)
Map Editor NEW Metal Barricades Tileset (44 new unique tiles)
Map Editor NEW Jungle Wooden Walls Tileset (70 new unique tiles)
Map Editor NEW Jungle Wooden Furniture Tileset (148 new unique tiles)
Map Editor NEW Jungle Bushes Tileset (60 new unique tiles)
Map Editor NEW Jungle Trees Tileset (104 new unique tiles)
Map Editor NEW Diagonal Roof Tileset (3 new unique tiles)
Map Editor NEW Jungle Leaves Tileset (14 new unique tiles)
Map Editor NEW Underwater Rocks Tileset (116 new unique tiles)
Map Editor NEW Item Spawner with new Weapon/Gadgets Tiles (10 new unique tiles)

 JUNGLE SKIN PACK  
NOTE: This DLC only contains aesthetic content.
No "Pay to Win" and no kind of gameplay advantage content is included and never will be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6241274/39b171976c13bdf681c0299a564368242debdd15.png

BUGFIX & CHANGES

- Less water visibility at night

NEW MAP 
- OF_River Village 
[/code] 

 New Level Cap and Badges  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6241274/b37d47c2a380d4f9f6c956b7325670d99990c9fd.png
 NEW MAP - OF_River Village  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6241274/f88b6cacd8b3bcf9c1b8fd1cbf6566917334142f.png
https://i.imgur.com/DMRJgIB.gif
Quick map description:
River Village is an unusual map,
is set on a rural jungle place and there are no interactive lights, the ambient is mostly lit by torches and a few static electric lights.
This time the Guards team will spawn in the bottom part of the map.
Movements develops diagonally with only three entrances in the fortified area.

NOTE: For now you need to manually install the map from the in-game map Browser, the map will be added as Featured (installed as default) soon.

MODE COMPATIBILITY:
All modes except  SOC and Racing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6241274/bb3c65f2af8c4bb1361d14bc0490f0a88aa158ef.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6241274/bb78fd481a839e1a19a196ecee0159d01b2cf4b9.png
 CLASSIC MAPS COME BACK 
We're happy to announce that almost all the old Classic OGAT Map are coming back.
The maps that will be released over the next 2 weeks are,

Mansion
Military Camp
Police Department
Cemetery

Also CLASSIC VR MAPS will be added back again
Old VR Maps will be probably released with another FREE DLC,
and in addition to maps it will include a new set of VR themed tiles for the map editor.

 CLASS UNLOCK PROGRESSION SURVEY  
This survey has the purpose of collecting users' opinion about how the class unlocking system is managed.

In particular the sequence of classes to be unlocked, and the time needed to unlock the complete pool of classes.

Please take your time to analyze the data and think about your proposals.
The changes in terms of gameplay could be very important.
Just think about a "little" change like the move of the Cobra, from a default to advanced class, it means that 80% of players will no longer be able to use the cobra.

These changes will greatly change the balance of the matches, hopefully for the better, and our goal is precisely to try to improve the game experience for both new and old players.

Survey Argument Summary:
- Class Unlock Progression speed
- Class Unlock order

Our main goal is to collect datas and feedback from the entire userbase, both new and old players,
 TO DO THAT PLEASE USE THIS SURVEY https://forms.gle/xPLuk14gMPj5iqWc8  

If you need help reach us on the official OGAT Discord server!

 Of Guards and Thieves  - Update 92.10 - Experimental Update Round.1 and public Survey

Hi everyone! In the last announcement (https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/302590/view/3220576521104248959) we've talked about the new incoming Free DLC called "Hunting Grounds"
and we've dediced to start releasing all the new content with a series of experimental updates,

  OGAT Update 92.10 Survey  (ROUND 1) 
Our main goal is to collect datas and feedback from the entire userbase, both new and old players,
remember, this updated is a experimental update and we're going to change stuff again and again with the next experimental updates iteraction.
So please, be polite with your feedback and feel free to express your considerations.

  TO DO THAT PLEASE USE THIS SURVEY - https://forms.gle/U2F6nTE922JsLRPj7  
This survey (V.1) is about changes introduced in the latest game update (r.92.10)
If you haven't played it please don't answer this survey, try the game first and think about your consideration, don't jump to any conclusion in seconds but take your time to get confident with the changes.

Also, we're running a series of experimental updates in order to collect datas and feedback from the entire userbase, this is just the round.1.

Survey V.1 Argument Summary:
- Camera Angle
- Camera Offset
- Rebalance Idea
- Features and Content wishlist
- Development consideration

HAVE FUN AND STAY AT HOME!
Thanks!

 Improvements and changes 
- Interactive Vegetation
- Improved Weapon shoot VFX
- Improved Debris VFX
- Improved Ragdoll effect on players death
- Added equipment swap animations


 New Camera System 
- New camera offset system
- Camera angle changed to 65°  (was 75°, next test will be 70°)
- 1.2m offset for every weapon
- 3m offset for "sniping" weapon (AVP-Hunting Rifle)

It is a standard for practically all top-down shooter games,
simplifying, the system makes the game camera follow the mouse cursor.
This allows you to add immersion and depth to the gameplay.

OGAT was born with this idea but has never been implemented, we are currently doing tests to integrate this solution and in the survey there are several setup options.

PLEASE NOTE: Rate both the system and the actual setup, values can be changed and different tests will be made with different configuration, such offset range, camera speed, acceleration and more values.

Games with Camera Offset
(Foxhole - Running with rifle - Nuclear Throne - Hotline Miami - Alien Swarm - The Hong Kong Massacre - Enter The Gungeon - Hatred and much more, practically all games have it with slightly different setups)

 Rebalance V.1 
PLEASE NOTE: All the rebalance changes are in testing, expect further changes soon
- Deploy time changed to 0.3s (was 0.1) and match the animations lenght
- Time between grenades changed to 1.4s (was 1s)

SNIPER REBALANCE
- Sniper HP 72 to 70

CARRIER REBALANCE
- XN8 more precision - improved recoil recover
- Carrier HP 76 to 80

ASSAULT REBALANCE
- N4 damage 24 to 22

GUARDIAN REBALANCE

PYRO REBALANCE

SABOTEUR REBALANCE
- Increase MP5 K SD Damage to 16
- Add 1 Molotov

JUGGERNAUT REBALANCE
- HKusp SD to Glock SD
- AZ damage 24 to 22

SHADOW REBALANCE
- Crossbow damage 23 to 22

MERC REBALANCE
- added one pistol magazine

MEDIC THIEF REBALANCE
- Thief Medic 62 to 66 hp
- Thief Medic add first aid spray (3 to 4 mag)

  Current available content from Hunting Ground DLC 

NEW CONTENT:

MAP EDITOR - Over +500 new  jungle themed objects
MAP EDITOR - New Jungle terrain texture layer
New Guard Class - Sniper
New Thief Class - Hunter
New Weapon - AWP (rifle)
New Weapon - Hunting Rifle (rifle)
New Weapon - Hunting Knife (melee)
New Weapon - Zakarov SD (pistol)

New Gadget - Blue Glow Stick

notes.notes:
Of Guards and Thieves r.87 - Racing, Graphics engine update, Vehicles, experimental Sandbox TDM mode, new map editor content and more!  
Update 87.53
Hi everyone! OGAT update 87 is finally out.
This update has been a long journey but we have lots of improvements and additions this time.


Here the most relevant contents,

 New Sandbox TDM (sbTDM) mode hosting for Gold users
 Racing is now free to play with upgraded features
 New Racing skins available for PGA and FA dlc.
 Improved performance and netcode
 Improved graphics engine
 Item Spawner for Training and sbTDM mode
 Vehicles now available in Map Editor, and compatible with almost every game mode such as GaT / DE / TDM / MB / ZR / etc
 Terrain sculpt in Map Editor
 Over 900 new objects available in map editor
 Water availability for custom maps
 Racing is now compatible with custom maps
 Training is now compatible with custom maps
 Permanent gold account DLC upgraded with Gold Skins and new Avatars
 7 new languages translation available in-game
 New dedicated server for Asia and US-West
 53 unlockable achievements
 Level cap increased to 70


 Racing and vehicles 

Of Guards and Thieves - Racing includes a new Free to Play Racing game mode with three unique vehicles, new classes, skins and 5 new official racing maps.
Plus we added the support in the Map Editor for Racing mode and tons of new map editor tiles that will allow you to build your racing circuits!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K9tHcHcQHF4

https://store.steampowered.com/app/824890/Of_Guards_and_Thieves__Racing/

Racing Key Features

Racing game mode (Time Attack type)
Day & Night cycle
6 New Official Racing Maps
Custom Map support for Racing mode 
 Map Editor integration with more than 700 new unique placeable tiles
3 Unique Vehicles, Car, Quad, Kart with many color variations
New Racing classes
Different terrain type physics (Off Road / Asphalt / Dirt) with unique driving style
New Avatars


New Official Racing Maps

 Driving School
 Racing Track
 Small Racing Track
 Motocross Track
 Rally Track
 Rallycross Track


New Map Editor Content

Map Editor NEW Asphalt Roads Tileset (26 unique tiles with 4 variants - 104 in total)
Map Editor NEW Dirt Roads Tileset (26 unique tiles with 4 variants - 104 in total)
Map Editor NEW Dirt Rally Ramps (18 unique tiles with 4 variants - 72 in total)
Map Editor NEW Curbs Tileset (40 unique tiles with 3 color variants - 120 in total)
Map Editor NEW Tyre Walls Tileset (18 unique tiles with 7 color variants - 126 in total)
Map Editor NEW Guardrails Tileset (50 unique tiles with 4 color variants - 200 in total)
Map Editor NEW Metal Fences tiles (x2)
Map Editor MEW Tyre Trails Tileset (30 unique tiles with 3 color variants - 90 in total)
 Map Editor NEW Ads Space tilesets (22 unique tiles)


 Sandbox TDM 
This game mode is experimental and will allow you to create and play your own personalized gaming experience.

All players will start at the beginning with a simple metal pipe as weapon, they will have to search for new equipment on the map, trying to survive by collaborating with their teammates.

This starting point and the freedom offered by the map editor will allow you to create unique gaming experiences.
Through the use of the map editor, it is possible to place the item spawners, which will generate pools of random objects during the game, and other interactive objects such as vehicles, doors, switches and other mechanisms

Sandbox TDM also has the Day&Night cycle support.

Day&Night cycle in action.
https://i.imgur.com/pptfbI9.gif

It is possible to collect, exchange and steal items from other players, such as weapons, ammunition, food, drinks, medicines and more.


 These interactions are available thanks to the inventory accessible with the Q key, and by collecting the objects on the ground pointing at it with the mouse cursor and pressing E key
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6241274/4217c0bc0bb83e89f35d43405defd515c46d6fb0.png

At the moment there is only one official map (OF_Construction Yard) designed for this game mode, but thanks to the compatibility with custom maps, you can find a rich amount of maps created by the users, or you can create your own map thanks to the map editor.
Also, new official maps will be released later on.

notes.title: OGAT - Update 87 Preview - Racing, sbTDM, Tropical and more!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, here's a quick update on the current development state.

As you have certainly noticed we have not released updates in a long time,
the main reason is that along with the development of a whole series of new content, we are stuck a bit on rewriting and optimizing of a good part of the netcode and other very old code that we brought with us since the first version of the game.
This work will finally allow us to solve and detect a whole series of very old bugs, including all the wrong class problems, respawn bugs, netcode performance and other annoying things.

Also, we've upgraded our graphic engine, this change allows us to improve several things, including:

 Considerable performance boost both on CPU, GPU and RAM usage
 Directx 11 support
 Improved lighting, graphic appearance, particles effects and more
 Improve post-processing effects (New Antialiasing / Ambient Occlusion / Bloom and other effects)
 Customizable LUT Color Grading effects
 Improved and faster physics


Unfortunately, this type of changes are prevents us from releasing intermediate updates, forcing us to complete the whole rewriting of the code and engine porting before being able to release a new public stable update.

The good news is that we are officially in testing phase and fix,
we're currently working with our Beta Tester group and we hope to achieve a stable major release in weeks.

Another good news, the next will probably be the most substantial updates ever released, not only regarding the technical bits but also new gameplay content.
Some of the most important additions are surely the introduction of an experimental sbTDM update, hostable by clients, a richer training mode, the addition of the in-game inventory for these modes, in-game day & night cycle, background environmental sounds, the addition of vehicles (initially on Racing, sbTDM, Training ) which will soon be made available also for all other modes.
Also 2 new classes, with new gadgets and weapons are almost ready together with a rich content updates for the map editor, which will be enriched with more than 1400 new items based on Racing and Tropical Jungle theme, plus Tropical themed skins dlc, new maps, important bug fix and important new bugs of course (:p) and more.

All of the above is going to give players, and map creators, in particular, more freedom and creative possibilities with a whole range of new gameplay possibilities.

For more details, I have just updated the public board on Trello with the recent changes and currently in progress stuff, board available here -> 
 https://trello.com/b/nIaR1oR2/of-guards-and-thieves-development-roadmap  

An in-deep article with more information, images, and detailed changelogs will be released within the next major update.

Of Guards and Thieves - Update 85 
Update 85 Switches and Circuits Update v.1 and more!
https://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png
Hi guys! Update 85 is now available!

OGAT 85.5 changelog 
Switches and Circuits Update v.1
Switches and Interactive Lights/Objects are now available inside the Map Editor!

 New Map Editor "Wiring Mode" (enable it holding SHIFT key)
 Map Editor: New graphic style for the "classic" Red lightswitches 
 Map Editor: New Blue Switch (Control unit cabinet)
 Map Editor: New Orange Switch (Lever)
 Map Editor: New Junction Boxes (Red - Blue - Orange)
 New Graphics and New Sounds for Switches
 New Pointlights colors (x20 tiles) (Red wire circuit)
 x1 New Interactive Street Lamp (Blue wire circuit)
 x3 New Bulleproof Light Panel (Blue wire circuit)
 x3 New Bulletproof Shutter Metal wall (Orange wire circuit)
 x3 New Destructible Wooden Barricade (located in Furniture layer / Misc tileset)
 x2 New Wooden destructible doors


Fixes and Improvements**

 Map Editor performance improvements
 Improved Custom Map download
 DEDICATED SERVER FIX: Crash after many matches probably solved
 CPU usage improvements for both Dedicated Server and Player-hosted Server


 Switches and Circuits Update v.1 
Build your maps with a more interactive and engaging environment: you can finally use lightswitches, interactive lights and electrical objects in the Map Editor for all you custom map building needs!
https://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_85.5/OGAT_85.4_Switchoverview.png


 Circuit types and components 
Circuits are divided into different groups that are not compatible with each other and each group is indicated by a different color.

Switches
Used to control light source/mechanisms and other switches.
Junction Boxes
Useful to increase Switches effective range and to keep the wires tidy.
Lights and Interactive Objects
The final part of the circuit controlled by Switches.

Red circuit
Used for room pointlights.

 Red Switch
 Red Junction Box
 Colored Pointlights

https://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_85.5/OGAT_85.4_redcircuit.png


Blue circuit
Used for light emitter hardware.

 Blue Switch
 Blue Junctoin Box
 Streetlamp
 x3 Bulletproof Light Panels

https://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_85.5/OGAT_85.4_bluecircuit.png

Orange circuit
Used for mechanic hardware.

 Orange Switch
 Orange Junction Box
 x3 Metal Shutter Doors

https://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_85.5/OGAT_85.4_orangecircuit.png

More circuits and component will be added later!

 How to build circuits in your custom maps 
Steps
1) Hold SHIFT key to stay in wiring mode 
2) Move your character in front of a Switch/Box
3) Press LEFT MOUSE BUTTON on a Light or Switch to link/unlink it with the active Switch.
4) use the same system to link Switches of the same colors together if needed

Rules
- A single light can be linked only to a Switch at a time
- Switches can be linked to multiple switches within the same group/color
- Red Switches can be linked only to pointlights and other RED Switches/Boxes
- Blue Switches can be linked only to BLUE Switches/Boxes and Lights
- Orange Switches can be linked only to Orange Switches/Boxes and Mechanisms

 Destructible wooden barricades and wooden doors 
https://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_85.5/OGAT_85.4_wooden.png

notes.title: OGAT - Update 84 - Map Editor Update: Terrain Texture Painting system, Terrain Details Painting system, Breakable Windows/Covers , 130 new tiles and more!
notes.notes:
Of Guards and Thieves - Update 84 
Update 84 Terrain Texture Painting system, Terrain Details Painting system, Breakable Windows/Covers , 130 new tiles and more! 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png
Hi guys! Update 84  is now available!


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/500290/extras/LINE_TEXT_DLC_1.png 
OGAT 84 changelog 

 Map Editor Update: Terrain painting system
 Terrain Painting material set "NATURE Green" (8 new textures)
 New Terrain details painting system
 New Trees (42 new tiles)
 New Bushes (4 new tiles)
 New Ground Deco tileset "Decals" (20 new tiles)
 New Floor tileset Ground Details (60 new tiles)
 Map Editor update: Texture for Snow/Dirt debris
 Map Editor: Destructible Glass Windows
 Map Editor: Destructible passages covers
 Map Editor new tiles - Breakable Glass Walls


 Map Editor Terrain Painting system	 
In this update we added a completely new system for management of the Terrain, giving you more control to create and manage situations that were impossible before.
This new system consists of the possibility of painting the terrain with a brush, up to 8 different materials/textures for a single palette.

It's really easy and fast, also it's synchronized with other players, allowing you to paint simultaneously with your friends inside your server.

Only the first palette is available in this update, more textures palettes will be added later.
Materials/Textures list "GREEN" palette:

 Full Grass
 Dirty Grass
 Dirt
 Clay
 Soil
 Mud
 Sand
 Asphalt

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84_Painting%20Overview.png
Terrain Color Painting Overview

How to paint with textures
In order to paint your terrain you have to select the "TERRAIN" tab in the top right screen corner,
from here select the "Color" layer and the "NATURE GREEN" palette.

As default the terrain is filled with the first "Full Grass" texture, but you're free to change it with another texture: to do that just select your chosen texture and press the "Fill all with selected texture" button.

Then you can begin to paint: choose the desired texture and press the left mouse button on the ground.
The more you press the more color will be painted on the ground.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84_painting.gif
Terrain Color Painting in action

Mixing Textures and Paint Strengh
If you want to apply a light painting turn down the paint strengh bar.

How to create variations and nice looking grounds with textures
Color/Texture variations are really important in order to obtain a natural and nice looking terrain, 
we suggest to use texture combinations to achieve this result.

Here are some combinations example,
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_FullGrass_DirtyGrass.png
For Full Grass terrain type - "Full Grass" and "Dirty Grass" mixture
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_DirtyPassage.png
For Dirty roads/passages - "Dirt" and "Mud" mixture
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_FullDirt.png
For Full Dirty terrain type - "Dirt", "Mud" and "Clay mixture

 Map Editor Details Painting system	 
Similarly to the terrain painting system, this Details Painting system allows you to paint with "details" instead of textures.
Details can be grass, small plants, stones or other small objects.

First Set of pantaible Details includes 11 different objects,
Object preview with icon will be added soon!

 D0 - Grass 1
 D1 - Grass 2
 D2 - Grass 3
 D3 - Grass 4 tall
 D4 - Grass 5 dense
 D5 - Rocks
 D6 - Yellow Flower
 D7 - Red Flower
 D8 - Grass coverage small
 D9 - Grass coverage big
 D10 - Plant Tall

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84_Details%20Overview.png
Terrain Details Painting Overview

How to paint with details
Select the "Detail" layer, choose the desired object and press the left mouse button on the ground to paint your "detail" object.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84_paintingdetails.gif
Terrain Details Painting in action

How to create variations and nice looking grounds with details
In order to achieve a clean and natural terrain do not overdo with details painting and try to mix up 2/3 objects togheter.
Also uses detail objects in combination with the painted terrain textures.

Here are some combinations example,
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_Details_FullGrass.png
For Full Grass terrain type - with "Full Grass" texture use D8 as base and add D0/D1/D2 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_Details_DirtyGrass.png
For Dirty Grass terrain type - with "Full Grass/Dirty Grass" textures use D8 as base and add D9 for dense zone.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_Details_Dirt.png
For Full Dirt terrain type - with "Dirt/Mud/Clay" textures use only D5 Rocks and add D8 only where grass is present.

 New 162 tiles 

 New 42 Trees tiles	
 New 4 Bushes tiles

notes.notes:
Of Guards and Thieves - Update 84 
Update 84 Terrain Texture Painting system, Terrain Details Painting system, Breakable Windows/Covers , 130 new tiles and more! 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png
Hi guys! Update 84  is now available!


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/500290/extras/LINE_TEXT_DLC_1.png 
OGAT 84 changelog 

 Map Editor Update: Terrain painting system
 Terrain Painting material set "NATURE Green" (8 new textures)
 New Terrain details painting system
 New Trees (42 new tiles)
 New Bushes (4 new tiles)
 New Ground Deco tileset "Decals" (20 new tiles)
 New Floor tileset Ground Details (60 new tiles)
 Map Editor update: Texture for Snow/Dirt debris
 Map Editor: Destructible Glass Windows
 Map Editor: Destructible passages covers
 Map Editor new tiles - Breakable Glass Walls


 Map Editor Terrain Painting system	 
In this update we added a completely new system for management of the Terrain, giving you more control to create and manage situations that were impossible before.
This new system consists of the possibility of painting the terrain with a brush, up to 8 different materials/textures for a single palette.

It's really easy and fast, also it's synchronized with other players, allowing you to paint simultaneously with your friends inside your server.

Only the first palette is available in this update, more textures palettes will be added later.
Materials/Textures list "GREEN" palette:

 Full Grass
 Dirty Grass
 Dirt
 Clay
 Soil
 Mud
 Sand
 Asphalt

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84_Painting%20Overview.png
Terrain Color Painting Overview

How to paint with textures
In order to paint your terrain you have to select the "TERRAIN" tab in the top right screen corner,
from here select the "Color" layer and the "NATURE GREEN" palette.

As default the terrain is filled with the first "Full Grass" texture, but you're free to change it with another texture: to do that just select your chosen texture and press the "Fill all with selected texture" button.

Then you can begin to paint: choose the desired texture and press the left mouse button on the ground.
The more you press the more color will be painted on the ground.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84_painting.gif
Terrain Color Painting in action

Mixing Textures and Paint Strengh
If you want to apply a light painting turn down the paint strengh bar.

How to create variations and nice looking grounds with textures
Color/Texture variations are really important in order to obtain a natural and nice looking terrain, 
we suggest to use texture combinations to achieve this result.

Here are some combinations example,
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_FullGrass_DirtyGrass.png
For Full Grass terrain type - "Full Grass" and "Dirty Grass" mixture
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_DirtyPassage.png
For Dirty roads/passages - "Dirt" and "Mud" mixture
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_FullDirt.png
For Full Dirty terrain type - "Dirt", "Mud" and "Clay mixture

 Map Editor Details Painting system	 
Similarly to the terrain painting system, this Details Painting system allows you to paint with "details" instead of textures.
Details can be grass, small plants, stones or other small objects.

First Set of pantaible Details includes 11 different objects,
Object preview with icon will be added soon!

 D0 - Grass 1
 D1 - Grass 2
 D2 - Grass 3
 D3 - Grass 4 tall
 D4 - Grass 5 dense
 D5 - Rocks
 D6 - Yellow Flower
 D7 - Red Flower
 D8 - Grass coverage small
 D9 - Grass coverage big
 D10 - Plant Tall

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84_Details%20Overview.png
Terrain Details Painting Overview

How to paint with details
Select the "Detail" layer, choose the desired object and press the left mouse button on the ground to paint your "detail" object.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84_paintingdetails.gif
Terrain Details Painting in action

How to create variations and nice looking grounds with details
In order to achieve a clean and natural terrain do not overdo with details painting and try to mix up 2/3 objects togheter.
Also uses detail objects in combination with the painted terrain textures.

Here are some combinations example,
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_Details_FullGrass.png
For Full Grass terrain type - with "Full Grass" texture use D8 as base and add D0/D1/D2 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_Details_DirtyGrass.png
For Dirty Grass terrain type - with "Full Grass/Dirty Grass" textures use D8 as base and add D9 for dense zone.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_Details_Dirt.png
For Full Dirt terrain type - with "Dirt/Mud/Clay" textures use only D5 Rocks and add D8 only where grass is present.

 New 42 Trees tiles	
 New 4 Bushes tiles
 New 20 Ground Deco tiles, tileset "Decals"
 New 60 Floor tiles in Ground Details

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_84/OGAT_84.0_Trees.png

Of Guards and Thieves - Update r.83 
Update r.83 includes New Maps, Massive Map Editor upgrade, Report system, and more.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png
Hi guys! Update r.83  is now available!


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/500290/extras/LINE_TEXT_DLC_1.png 
OGAT r.83 changelog 
Generic Features

 New customizable mouse cursors option	
 AFK prevention feature
 3 new public maps - created inside the in-game map editor as samples
 Loading Screen - Map preview image for Custom Maps
 In-Game map image now available for Custom Maps (M button while in-game)
 New Report player window (available through ESC menu while in-game)


Map Editor Update

 New "Delete map" button
 New "Duplicate map" button
 Fast tiles placing for floors and walls
 Map image preview inside settings tab (or using the [M] key)
 GaT/CTF/gCTF/igCTF/ZR/VIP/DE gamemode support in Map Editor and Custom Maps


Bug fixes & improvements

 Kill Log improvements (your player name is now highlighted)
 FIX: Flashlight does not break when an object is destroyed in front of it
 FIX: Wrong throwable object collision with fence walls/doors
 Improved layout visibility for Wooden Fences/Doors in dark areas (Orange color indicator instead of generic grey)
 FIX: improved tile heights to z-fight problems
 Custom Map upload and networking improvements
 Medic rebalance: +1 Syringe Rifle Magazine (both guard/thief medic)
 Map Editor "Builder" class: Zlock magazine changed to 12 (was 5)



 New customizable mouse cursors option	 
Mouse cursor is now customizable in the Settings menu.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_cursors.png
Custom cursors
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83.0_cursors2.png

 AFK prevention feature 
Player will be automatically kicked out of Dedicated Servers if inactive.

 x3 New Maps available for anyone. 
3 new official maps are now added into the game as an example for the editor capability.
These maps are installed by default for everyone and are marked with a green icon inside your maps list.

OF_Winter Wars
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83.0_WinterWars.png
A little map with snow theme designed mainly for TDM/gTDM/MB/IG but also compatible with GaT/DE/CTF/gCTF/igCTF/ZR.

OF_Squared Arena
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83.0_SquaredArena.png
A little map with a VR look, designed for TDM/gTDM/MB/IG/CTF/gCTF/igCTF.

OF_Snipe Training
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83.0_SnipeTraining.png
A little map with a VR look, designed for train reflex and aim, compatible with TDM/gTDM/MB/IG.

 Custom Maps image 
Both Loading screen images and In-Game map images are now available for custom maps
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83.0_LoadingCustom.png
Loading screen preview
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83.0_MapImageCustom.png
In-Game map image (M button)

 Report Player feature 
From now will be possible to report other players for rules infringement like chat spamming, teamkilling, cheating, inappropriate words and behaviour.
Reports have no immediate/direct effects but are saved for further analysis and measures by the moderators.

To report a player you need to open the Report Menu, available from the ESC menu while you are in-game.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_ReportESC.png
ESC menu with REPORT button
This menu shows the list of all the players present in the game.

 MAP EDITOR UPDATE 
 New "Map Deletion" Map Editor feature
From now it's possible to delete unused custom map, the process is not reversible so be careful with that!

 New "Duplicate Map" Map Editor feature
From now it's possible to duplicate existent map, 
this process is particularly useful for reusing previously created layouts, lile "full black floor map" and premade building/zone, 
or for creating alternative versions of existing maps.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_DuplicateDelete.png
Delete and Duplicate button on Map Editor maps list.

 Map Editor Fast tiles placing for floors and walls 
From now on cover large areas with walls and floors will be easier and faster , 
keeping the left mouse button pressed will allow you to place these objects quickly without having to manually click each time.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_Fastplacing.gif

 Map image preview inside Settings tab 
From now on you can have an overview of your entire map thanks to the image available in the settings menu (or by pressing the [M] key).
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_MapEditPrew.png

More Gamemodes support for Custom maps
Finally, custom maps can be used in almost all gamemodes, here's the list:

 GaT
 TDM/gTDM/IG/MB
 DE
 VIP
 ZR
 CTF/gCTF/igCTF


How to setup your custom maps for Gamemodes
Each map needs a certain list of objects to be present in order to be compatible with a certain game mode.
Be sure to have these objects placed in your map space otherwise the map will be not shown in your playable maps list.

TDM - gTDM - IG - MB 
These mode only requires the player's spawn points, make sure you have placed enough of them in order to avoid multiple player to be spawn int the same spot.
We recommend using at least 12 spawn points for each team, also keep in mind that spawn points are required for all game modes.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_spawns.png
*At the moment Spawn Points are shared between all gamemodes, if you need different spawn points for each gamemode right now the only way is to duplicate the map.

GaT 
The GaT gamemode requires at least one "Thieves Target" object and one "Thieves Exit Point"
List available GaT gameplay tiles,
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_gat.png
Each tile can be placed once

CTF/gCTF/igCTF
The CTF gamemode requires a "Flag Home" and "Capture Point" tiles for both teams.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_flags.png
Each tile can be placed once

DE
The DE gamemode requires at least one "Bomb Target".
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_de.png
Each tile can be placed once

VIP
The VIP mode requires one single "VIP Escape Point"
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_vip.png
Each tile can be placed once

ZR
The ZR mode requires at least one "Big Brain" as objective for the Zombie team.
As you know only one Brain will be available at a time in each game, the objective will be randomly select between all the brains available in the map.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_brains.png
Each tile can be placed once

Teleports 
Teleports are usable in all modes, but we recommend using them only in VR looking maps for gTDM/IG mode.
One single teleport is composed by one entry point and one exit point, easily recognizable in BUILD mode.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_83.0/OGAT_83_teleports.png
Each tile can be placed once

OGAT - Update r.82.5 - Fix, general improvements and community made Tournament.

 Of Guards and Thieves - Update r.82.5 
Update r.82.5 includes lots of Bug Fix and general improvements.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png
Hi guys!
Update r.82.5  is now available!


http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/FIREFIGHT/LINE TEXT_Content.png 
OGAT r.82.5 changelog 

 Improved Ragdoll with different bullets force by killer weapon
 Improved Hit Detection and Damage calculation
 Improved Melee Weapons Hit Detection - "Fake Hit" with no damage are no longer displayed as effective hit.
 New Death Icon on Tab player list
 New HP indicator (Full Dot/Half Dot/Empty Dot)
 NEW Equipment Deploy Time and Deploy Sound
 FIX: Dedicated Server occasional empty voting screen
 FIX: Flamethrower hit detection range wrong VFX render
 FIX: GaT objective visible as Spectator(Blue Team)
 FIX: Various Score calculation problems
 FIX: Occasional Persistent Shot pointlight with Medic/Shadow pistol
 FIX: Exp gain removed for Map Editor and Training Modes
 FIX: Improved Grenade hit detection
 FIX: WRONG MAPS LIST during voting phase.
 FIX: Wrong Team rating when level 1 player is present
 FIX: Little changes on Mansion/Military Camp
 ZR autobalance team composition changes, 65% Zombie - 35% Guards
 Added automatic AFK kick for Dedicated Servers
 Dedicated Servers - New settings: Free Team Build (used for Tournament private servers)
 Dedicated Servers - Now support map voting for single mode server
 Dedicated Servers - Custom Gamemodes list support
 Rebalance Pyro: Explosive Pistol ammo reduced to 2 (was 3)
 Generic Autobalance improvements

Another change that will be available in the next release is a better auto-balance algorithm.

The problem with the current one is that is *only* taking in consideration the average score during the matches and it's not considering the player experience.

The new algorithm it's still a simple one but we think it will be an improvement.

It works like this: every player will have a "rating" computed that it the result of 3 variables:

A = ( avg_score / 2000 ) * 0.5
B = total_wins / total_match_played
C = level / level_cap
RATING = A + B + C

http://image.prntscr.com/image/c775583e9fac42fd8b849601ae5badb4.png

notes.notes:
Of Guards and Thieves - Update r.81.5 
Classes/Loadouts Rebalance, Maps Remake, In-Game Map, Improved Exp gain and MORE!
http:///www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/InGame/Chara_Group_New.png

Hi guys,
Update r.81.5 is now available with tons of changes!


 OGAT r.81.5 changelog 

 Classes/Loadouts Rebalance (*check BELOW for details)
 Military Camp map Remake and Rebalance (*check BELOW for details)
 Cemetery map Remake and Rebalance (*check BELOW for details)
 Policed Department map improvements (*check BELOW for details)
 Mansion map improvements (*check BELOW for details)
 Rebalance EXP gain System - Total Exp gain increased x2.5
 Rewritten Respawn/Death system
 New Destructible Cover for Yellow/Green Passages (40 HP)
 Improved Map Loading Screen (custom map by Gamemodes with details)
 In-Game Map with gamemodes objectives and player position (opens with "M")
 gTDM/gCTF support for standard official map (Mansion, Office, Police Dep, Cemetery, Military Camp)
 New look and graphics for Thieves GaT Escape points.
 FIX: Damage on Respawn with Area Damage gadget fixed
 FIX: Weird body effect on death/respawn transition
 FIX: Occasional explosion damage during "death phase" does not happen anymore
 FIX: Wrong flag respawn counter when pickup after teamates death (CTF modes)
 FIX: Improved Flashlight collision detection
 FIX: Occasionally broken Objective Text showing information about the other team
 FIX: Voting system, server does not stop anymore with 0 votes.
 FIX: 0 Exp and k/d wrong count on result screen fixed.
 Improved Particles Performance
 Improved Sound System for Melee Weapons
 New Sounds for Scout Baton
 New Sounds for Guardian Baton
 New Sounds for Cobra Tactical Knife
 New Sounds for Crowbar
 New Sounds for Medic Syringe
 New Sounds for Plastic Knife
 New Sounds for Zombie Melee Attacks


 Classes/Loadouts Rebalance 
Classes rebalance aims to rebalance the game mechanics by giving more importance to the less used classes.
In this particular case we're going to buff Scout and Carrier for Guards and Cobra, Saboteur and Medic for Thieves faction.
Both classes statistics and loadouts stats have been changed in order to achieve this goal, details in the list below.
OGAT r.81.5 Classes/Loadouts Rebalance Details 

 Scout: HP changed 68 -> 72
 Scout: Zlock 18 replaced by WK usp
 Scout: Fluorescent Glue duration increased 12.5 -> 15.5
 Scout: Fluorescent Glue slowdown power increased 0.5 -> 0.6
 Scout: Fluorescent Glue Radius increased 0.6 -> 0.7
 Scout: Light Baton Damage increased 34 -> 36
 Scout: NP5 damage changed to 20 (was 18)
 Flare: Light Range increased 3.5 -> 4
 Carrier: HP changed 74 -> 76
 Saboteur: HP changed 70 -> 72
 Molotov: Duration changed 8.5 -> 11
 Incendiary Grenade: Duration changed 12.5 -> 15
 Cobra HP changed 48 -> 54

In this particular case we're going to buff Scout and Carrier for Guards and Cobra, Saboteur and Medic for Thieves faction.
Both classes statistics and loadouts stats will be changed in order to achieve this goal, all the details about the changes will be made public with the 81.0 update.

  Maps Improvements and Rebalance 
More used maps are Office and Mansion, there are reasons behind that and we want to fix this problem.
Maps Like Cemetery and Military camp in particular have some balancing problems, like too much darkness on main point of interest zones, exaggerated thieves advantages and not well-balanced objective placeament.

We've improved the situation by changing maps Layouts, Lighting, objectives placeament, Spawn zones and more.

Of Guards and Thieves - Update r.79.2 
Note: this is part of a series of updates with lots of changes under the hood that we need to test in order to proceed with the r.80.x release.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png

Hi guys,
Update r.79.2 is now available

 Main changes 
New VFX - Muzzle Flash, smoke effect for weapons, projectiles shell emission
*Note, Muzzle Flash effect is present only with non-silenced weapons
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_79.2/OGAT_79.2_VFX%201.png

 New VFX - Improved hit particles effect 
*The new hit effect on environment is not visible in dark areas
*Environment Hit effects depends on weapons type, there are 3 different effect type
*Being fired/stabbed inside a bush do not reveal your position easly anymore
*Being fired/stabbed in dark area do not reveal yout position easly anymore
*Added Blood effect on ground when you're hit, blood trace on the ground can be used as tactical information (bleed affect disappear in 4-5 seconds)
*Blood effects depends on weapons type, there are 5 different effect type
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_79.2/OGAT_79.2_VFX%202.png

 New Profile Menu 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_79.2/OGAT_79.2_Profile.png

  UI Email setup menu for Steam users 
*Now game ask to setup an email if you have not set yet
*You can change your mail inside the Profile menu
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_79.2/OGAT_79.2_Mail%20Setup.png

  New Loading screen with random hint, filtered by gamemode/team/map/level 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_79.2/OGAT_79.2_Loading%20Hints.png

 OGAT Updates r.78.4 to 79.2 complete changelog 
OGAT r.78.4 changelog

 NEW VFX: Muzzle Flash + smoke effect for weapons
 NEW VFX: Projectiles shell emission with physics when shooting 
 Little improvements to trail renderer for bullets
 Reworked Melee hit scan system
 Lot of changes for Map Editor server side networking code
 FIX - Wrong weapons assigment on death (Polaroid+Death Log)
 Reworked Yellow Passage hit scan detection
 Lower polaroid sound on death (-50% volume)
 FIX: Wrong slowdown effect with not broken windows
 FIX: Terrains collision height
 FIX: Weird bug with windows hit detection
 FIX: Stab/Shot when character adherent to Walls
 RIP Halloween decorations


OGAT r.78.5 changelog

 NEW VFX: New and improved Blood Effect 
 NEW VFX: New Hit effect for environment
 Supports for multiple contemporary hit particles
 FIX: Wrong bullet rotation for Parabellum projectiles
 FIX: Melee Hit scan for Big Brain fixed
 FIX: Caltrop are no longer invisible


OGAT r.78.6 changelog

 New VFX effect for Railgun (IG modes)
 FIX: No more invincible Big Brain in Zombie Rush mode
 Pumpkin ball for Soccer removed
 Reduced Backward speed malus for Sandbox mode classes
 Hit Environment VFX improvements
 Pump-Action Shotgun rebalance: Less distance damage falloff 
 FIX: Wrong Slowdown effect for windows on RiverCity map
 UI Email setup menu
 Friend List is now alphabetically ordered
 FIX: Stuttering audio fixed
 FIX: Wrong objective message for Guards in GaT.


OGAT r.78.7 changelog

 Improved Caltrop collision
 FIX: Office C1 Big Brain fixed
 UI Email setup menu for Steam users
 Reduced volume for MadBall explosions
 Optimized collision for all particles effect
 Optimized performance for Zombie related VFX
 Unified M4 Magazine type (compact MAG no longer 'available, standard MAG with 20 bullets are now used for every M4 variants)


OGAT r.79.0 changelog

 New Loading screen with random hint, filtered by gamemode/team/map/level
 Free Class with level unlock for "Free To Play" users
 Automatic Class unlock for "Gold" users
 Pop-up for locked class with requirements
 Free Avatars Guards and Thieves faction classes
 FIX soccer sounds


OGAT r.79.1 changelog

 Rewritten character movement netcode
 Rewritten 2d sound system
 New Personal Profile Menu v.1
 Chat Beep sound replaced


OGAT r.79.2 changelog

 New netcode fix and improvements



 For any questions feel free to contact us on our official Discord Server or Community Forum. 

 DISCORD Official Server 
https://discordapp.com/assets/fc0b01fe10a0b8c602fb0106d8189d9b.png
Official Discord server is now available!  
If you want to invite other players please use this link →  https://discord.gg/VQbBwxm  
*Discord is available as Browser application and Standalone client for Win/Mac/Linux iOS and Android.
Check here to download the client -   https://discordapp.com/apps  


Official Community Forum →  http://www.subvertgames.com/community  

 Development roadmap board on Trello 
OGAT Development roadmap is now available on Trello board.

HERE THE BOARD → https://trello.com/b/nIaR1oR2

notes.title: OGAT - Update r.78.3
notes.notes:
http://cdn2.subvertgames.com/static/OGAT_NEWS_LEFT_01_HalloweenFree.png
 Of Guards and Thieves - Update r.78.3 Halloween Sales, Free Weekend, Discord, BugFix and more. 
Hi guys,
Of Guards and Thieves update 78.3 is now available.
Note: this is a preparation update with lots of changes under the hood that we need to test in order to proceed with the next updates.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png

 HALLOWEEN SALES 
OGAT is part of the Steam Halloween Sales with a -40% discount and Free weekend event until Tuesday November 1.

HALLOWEEN DECORATIONS
Maps are decorated with Halloween stuff for the duration of the event
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_64.0/OGAT_64_deco_02.jpg

 FREE WEEK END 
During the FREE WEEKEND every Demo/Free to play account get the opportunity to try all the premium features during the weekend. 
You'll be able to use all the maps, classes, gamemodes and map editor, enjoy ;-)

* Free Week End event will last until Tuesday November 1!

 DISCORD Official Server 
https://discordapp.com/assets/fc0b01fe10a0b8c602fb0106d8189d9b.png
Official Discord server is now available!  
If you want to invite other players please use this link →  https://discord.gg/VQbBwxm  
*Discord is available as Browser application and Standlone client for Win/Mac/Linux iOS and Android.
Check here to download the client -   https://discordapp.com/apps  

If you need a private voice/text channel please read carefully.
Minimum requirements
You need a group of active friends to apply for the request, not to send the request if you are alone or under 5 active members.
Incomplete requests and / or made with fake emails will not be accepted.
If you do not respect the requirements you can use the temporary rooms.

REQUEST FORM
*copy and paste on your email.
- In-Game username (OGAT username)
- Identity proof: OGAT CD-KEY/account registration email
- Group/Clan name: -name here-
- Number of members: -number-

Do not give this information to anyone, send them via e-mail only to support@subvertgames.com

 Development roadmap board on Trello 
OGAT Development roadmap is now available on Trello board, definitely more readable, clear and comfortable to update and manage.

HERE THE BOARD → https://trello.com/b/nIaR1oR2

Other helpful links:
Here the updates/changelog list: "Previous updates/changelog list"
Here the updates full articles list: "Full Updates Articles List"
Here the Actual game content list,
- "Actual game content list (Steam Forum)"
- "Actual game content list (Community Forum)"

 Update Changelog 
OGAT r.78.0
	
 MultiShoot weapons system
 (WIP) Reworked Pump-Action Shotgun *Damage 90 (30 for each buck)
 Security improvements and fix.
 Improved Main Menu
 New Login and authentication system
 Heavy code rewrite
 improved netcode
 FPS counter (on/off available in the Options menu)
 BUG FIX: Chat server random disconnection
 BUG FIX: Friend list synch
 BUG FIX: Out of synch Flashlight bug on first spawn
 BUG FIX: Improved grenade netcode
 BUG FIX: Last grenade kill doesn't cause ragdoll "freeze"
 BUG FIX: Missing shot/hit render (wrong magazine/bullet synch)
 FIX: Lower volume for Smoke Grenade and Flare.
 BUG FIX: Less lag after long session/long uptime.
 BUG FIX-Dedicated server: No-Damage grenades problem solved.
 BUG-FIX-Dedicated server: No more infinite ammo bug.
 Bomb Defusa, Bomb timer 30sec to 40sec
 quiter Lightswitch sound (20% reduction)
 "Crossbow standard" rebalance *Magazine Bolt (6 to 7 ammo)
 Halloween Decorations
 R.I.P webplayer (web browser version of OGAT is no longer available)

OGAT r.78.1
 FIX: chat server login issue
 BUGFIX: 1hp Death-Freeze
 BUGFIX: Flashlight on death body no longer appears
 BUGFIX: Flashlight on Shield no longer appears
 BUGFIX: Healing teammate with FullHP do not give Score
 BUGFIX: No more invisible Shield collider with primary weapons equipped (wrong 3dmodel still present)
 BUGFIX: Friendly Melee damage do not give positive score anymore
 BUGFIX: Office Map - Reception A lights synch

OGAT r.78.2

 FIX: Soccer "Freeze-Knife" fixed
 FIX: BSOD Admin "Black screen of death" when hosting VIP/Racing/Faceless fixed
 FIX: Other rare "Death-Freeze" effect fixed
 BUGFIX: Other minor bugfix
	

OGAT r.78.3

 FIX: Death body do not block doors anymore
 FIX: Death body do not block shoot anymore
 FIX: rare Flashlight drop on death for host fixed
 FIX: "Death Freeze" effect when killed with destroyed weapons
 FIX SOCCER: Protection collider after goal now disappear correctly
 FIX: Wrong weapon icon on death fixed (death log)
 FIX: Wrong respawn for bomb after death fixed
 FIX: (manual) Delete local cache file in order to fix invisible or wrong username in friend list
 Other minor fix and improvements.
	

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png

notes.title: OGAT - Update 76.0 Karts, Training mode, Shooting Range map, New Gadgets, Free weekend and more.
notes.notes:
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/InGame/OGAT_NEWS_RIGHT_FreeWeekEnd.png
 Of Guards and Thieves - Update 76.0 Karts, Training mode, Shooting Range map, New Gadgets, Free weekend and more. 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png

Hi guys,
Of Guards and Thieves update 76.0 is now available.
Also OGAT is part of the Steam Summer Sales with a -40% discount and Freeweek end event until Monday June 27.

 FREE WEEK END 
During the FREE WEEKEND every Demo/Free players the opportunity to try all the premium features during the weekend. 
You'll be able to use all the maps, classes, gamemodes and map editor, enjoy ;-)

* Free Week End event will last until Monday June 27!

Here's all the changes in this update:
 NEW CONTENT 
	
   Kart veichle now available in Racing gamemode
   Kart skins (x14)
   New Shooting Range Map
   In-Game Tutorial message system (available in Shooting Range map)
   New Training gamemode (Sandbox based with Standard Classes)
   New Cobra Gadget - Glue Bottle 
   New Shadow Gadget - Caltrop  
   New Guardian Gadget - Wooden Baton
   New Scout Gadget - Light Baton

Training mode and Shooting Range map are available both for Early Access and Free users.
 CHANGES 

   New Main Menu interface
   New tooltips graphics
   Flashligh now turns ON/OFF with "right mouse button" in all the gamemodes
   Item pick up is now managed with the "E" button.
   ZR team autobalance fix
   Improved Grenades networking

 Weapon/Gadgets/classes changes 

  Medic Syringe attack speed (0.3 to 0.35)
  Knife attack speed (0.2 to 0.3)
  Plastic knife attack speed (0.2 to 0.3)
  (Scout) "Glue Grenade" to "Fluorescent Glue Grenade"
  "Fluorescent Glue Grenade" Slowdown 0.3 to 0.5
  Crowbar damage (40 to 48)
  Crowbar attack delay: 0.35 to 0.45
  New Weapon: Automatic Crossbow (training only)
  New Weapon: Snipe Crossbow (training only)
  New Weapon: Syringe Pistol (training only)
  Zombie Fat HP: 90 to 110
  Zombie Tank HP: 120 to 140
  Juggernaut HP (85 to 84)
  AZ47 weight slow down value (0.5 to 0.6)
  AZ47 Reload speed (2.0 to 2.4)


 UPDATE 76.0 Details 

 KARTS 
New Kart veichle is now available in Racing gamemode.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/_DAILY/OGAT_Daily_27.png
 
 Kart Skins (x14)
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/_DAILY/OGAT_Daily_30.png
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/_DAILY/OGAT_Daily_31.png

 NEW MAP: Shooting Range 
Now available for Training game mode, Shooting Range map offers a new Sandabox Training experience,
with Targets, different training areas, and weapons/gadgets storage.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_75.6/NEWS_75.6_SR_Combine.png
available both for Early Access and Free users.

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_75.6/NEWS_75.6_SR_01.png
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_75.6/NEWS_75.6_SR_02.png
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_75.6/NEWS_75.6_SR_03.png
Shooting Range map details
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_75.6/NEWS_75.6_SR_MAP.png
Shooting Range map overview

 NEW MODE: Training  
Training mode is available both for Single player and Multiplayer experience.
This mode is based on Sandbox and use the new Inventory System with interactive objects, day/night cycle and more.
available both for Early Access and Free users.

Dummy/Target for Shooting Range gamemode.
Used in Shooting Range Map, two type of target with different mechanics.
- Static/Indestructible Target (left) give the caused damage as text, useful for studying weapons and gadget mechanics.
- Destructible Target/Baloon (right) can be destroyed with a single hit, useful to create time trial and challenges.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/_DAILY/OGAT_Daily_19.png

In-Game Tutorial message system (available in Shooting Range map)
Used to explain game mechanics to new players in training mode.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_75.6/NEWS_75.6_TUT_01.png

 NEW GADGETS  
New Cobra Gadget - Glue Bottle
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/_DAILY/OGAT_Daily_33.png
 Glue Bottle works like Scout Glue Grenade but have a little slow down power and is not visible in dark areas.
-Slow down Power: 0.4
-Duration: 11 seconds
-Weight: 0.8
-Wieght Speed reduction: 0.1
-Inventory setup: x3 Glue Bottle available for Cobra
-*Not visible in dark areas

New Shadow Gadget - Caltrop
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/_DAILY/OGAT_Daily_34.png
 Caltrop cause slow down and damage when you step on.
-Hit Damage: 15
-Area Damage x second: 6
-Slow down Power: 0.3
-Duration: 13 seconds
-Weight: 0.6
-Wieght Speed reduction: 0.1
-Inventory setup: x3 Caltrop available for Shadow
-*Not visible in dark areas

New Guardian Gadget - Wooden Baton
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_75.6/Eb_Baton%20Wood_01.png
Melee weapon for Guardian class.
-Weight: 1.5
-Speed Weight: 0.1
-Damage: 40
-Range: 1.7
-Attack delay: 0.40

New Scout Gadget - Light Baton
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_75.6/Eb_Baton%20Metal_01.png
Melee weapon for Scout class.
-Weight: 1.2
-Speed Weight: 0.1
-Damage: 34
-Range: 1.7
-Attack delay: 0.35

 NEW MAIN MENU  
New Buttons and Training mode available as Single Player mode.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/_DAILY/OGAT_Daily_32.png
For any bug report, feedback or suggestion use the Steam Forum.
That's all for now!

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png

notes.title: OGAT - Update 74.21 Map Editor is out!
notes.notes:
Of Guards and Thieves - Update 74 Map Editor and stuff! 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png
Hi guys, finally the Map Editor v.1 is available for everyone!

It took us a lot of time and a huge amount of work but it's a really important addition to the game that will give the players a
potentially infinite map amount and a way to express your creativity.

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_EditorOverview.png

Here the content list for the update 74
Map Editor 1.0
	
		 More than 800 unique objects
		 6 unique layer
		 41 unique tileset
		 Local loading/saving of maps
		 Online multiplayer map editing
		 Basic pixel painting
		 Limited gamemodes compatibility (TDM-IG-gTDM-VIP-MadBall) (other gamemodes will be added gradually with new updates)
		 100x100 meters of editable space
	

New content and bug fixes
	
		 New class: Meat Zombie
		 Healing abilities for Meat Zombie
		 Meat Zombie Avatar
		 Level Cap upped to Level 40
		 FIX: Second grenade now deal the correct amount of damage
		 Networking improvements
		 BALANCE: Fat Zombie rebalance. 
	
 Map Editor v.1  
	Here's a quick video preview that shows how to create a medium size house and some outdoor vegetation.

Tons of unique assets  
	Map Editor assets are organized in LAYERS, TILESETS and TILES and feature more than 800 placeable objects.
	"Layers" works as main category selection tool, "tilesets" rapresent a further subdivision into a specific sets of objects,
	and "tiles" are the specific objects that you can place into the scene.
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_EditorGui.png

	7 different layers for a total of 892 different tiles, subdivided in 53 tilesets.
	
		 Floors - 4 tilesets with 78 tiles
		 Layout - 14 tilesets with 297 tiles
		 Furniture - 17 tilesets with 236 tiles
		 Ground Decoration - 11 tilesets with 132 tiles
		 Lights - 3 tilesets with 38 tiles
		 Roof - 1 tilesets with 1 tiles
		 Gameplay - 3 tilesets with 48 tiles
	
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_TileShowcase.png

Map Editor Guide
	 If you need in-deep information and guidelines about the Map Editor check the official guide here: (LINK GUIDA) 

Map Creation and Sharing
	 Map Creation, Saving and Loading
	To create a new map click the "New Map" button available inside the gamemode selection screen as host.

	Click "Host a new game" button.
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_NewGame.png

	Setup your game room name and options *(Keep in mind that if you don't put any password everyone will be able to join your room with editing permissions).
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_ServerSetup.png

	Select the "Map Editor" game mode.
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MapEditorMode.png

	Create a new map by clicking the "New Map" button, select the new "untitled map" and start the game.
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_NewMap.png

	Saving your custom maps
	The map can be saved from the map editor gamemode in the dedicated "SETTINGS" section available in the top right corner of your screen.

	Enter your map title and click the "SAVE" button to save the map in your hard drive. 
	NOTE: the map won't be saved automatically, you have to do it manually, be sure to save the map often. 
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MapSave.png

	Loading/Playing your custom maps
	Your custom maps (with the wrench icon) are listed alongside the official maps in the gamemodes/maps selection screen, just choose the desidered map and launch the game.

	Simply select your custom map and start the match.
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_CustomMapTDM.png

	Map Sharing
	We're building an integrated system to save maps in the cloud and share them but at the moment the only way to share a map is to do it manually.
	Right now every map is saved with an unique Map ID in this folder (Documents/Subvert Games/OGAT/maps).

	Retrieve the desidered map ID inside the gamemodes/maps selection screen  
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MapLoad.png

	Look for the map file with the correct map ID inside your (Documents/Subvert Games/OGAT/maps) folder.  
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MapID.png

	Send the map file to your friends or feel free to publish it on our official community forum (link forum) or Steam forum (link steam forum)

	IMPORTANT NOTE!  Sharing your maps means that you're giving it entirely to another user, meaning that the new user will be able to edit and rename the map.
	If you are afraid about copyright and map stealing issues do not share your maps until the official sharing tool is released.

	NOTE: In the future Map Editor update maps will be saved directly online on our servers, and there will be an in-game workshop that allow users to publish, share and rate maps. 

	 Quit the Map Editor mode 
	Click the "Quit" button in the SETTINGS tab to return into the Lobby.
	REMINDER: Save the map before quitting the editor!!! 

Editor Tools and Controls
	Map Editor have 4 different main tool, each one has a precise use and features.

	BUILD - The core of the Editor, allow to place and delete objects using the tiles browser.
	TEST - This mode allow to quick test the map.
	SETTINGS - Contain different options and controls (map title/save/sun control/quit button)
	SELECTION & EDIT - (*not available yet) Will be used to setup interactive object ID's and stuff such lights, lightswitches, objectives and more.
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_EditorTab.png

 Online map editing 
	Map Editor allow you to create maps online with other players, basically you can chose between 3 different server settings.
	 Private server : Select a password during the game creation phase, doing this you can avoid griefers. Give the password to your friends if you want them to join in.
	 Open Server with Spectating mode : Open server without password. turn OFF the spectator autojoin option inside the lobby options area. With this setup other players can spectate your game without editing and chat permission.
	 Open Server : Open server without password. Everyone can join your server with editing permission, be careful about griefers. If someone mess up your map just quit the editor without saving and change the server rules.

 New Class: Meat Zombie!  
	The Meat Zombie is a support class equipped with 2 healing abilities and one melee attack.
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MeatZombie.png
 Meat Zombie Stats

	 HP: 55
	 Movement Speed: 4.6
	 Melee damage: 25 hp
	 Melee Attack Speed: 0.3s
	 Healing touch: +10 hp
	 Healing touch speed: 0.45

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_BloodPool.png

Healing Spit
The Healing Spit ability creates a pool of curative blood that heals allies and enemies that pass through.


Type: AO heal
Healing power: +10 hps


http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_BloodPool.png

New Avatar
Meat Zombie avatar is now available as Avatar.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MeatAvatar.png

 Level Cap upped to Level 40
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_Levels.png

	The map can be saved from the map editor gamemode in the dedicated "SETTINGS" section available in the top right corner of your screen.

	Enter your map title and click the "SAVE" button to save the map in your hard drive. 
	NOTE: the map won't be saved automatically, you have to do it manually, be sure to save the map often. 
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MapSave.png

	Loading/Playing your custom maps
	Your custom maps (with the wrench icon) are listed alongside the official maps in the gamemodes/maps selection screen, just choose the desidered map and launch the game.

	Simply select your custom map and start the match.
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_CustomMapTDM.png

	Map Sharing
	We're building an integrated system to save maps in the cloud and share them but at the moment the only way to share a map is to do it manually.
	Right now every map is saved with an unique Map ID in this folder (Documents/Subvert Games/OGAT/maps).

	Retrieve the desidered map ID inside the gamemodes/maps selection screen  
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MapLoad.png

	Look for the map file with the correct map ID inside your (Documents/Subvert Games/OGAT/maps) folder.  
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MapID.png

	Send the map file to your friends or feel free to publish it on our official community forum (link forum) or Steam forum (link steam forum)

	IMPORTANT NOTE!  Sharing your maps means that you're giving it entirely to another user, meaning that the new user will be able to edit and rename the map.
	If you are afraid about copyright and map stealing issues do not share your maps until the official sharing tool is released.

	NOTE: In the future Map Editor update maps will be saved directly online on our servers, and there will be an in-game workshop that allow users to publish, share and rate maps. 

	 Quit the Map Editor mode 
	Click the "Quit" button in the SETTINGS tab to return into the Lobby.
	REMINDER: Save the map before quitting the editor!!! 

Editor Tools and Controls
	Map Editor have 4 different main tool, each one has a precise use and features.

	BUILD - The core of the Editor, allow to place and delete objects using the tiles browser.
	TEST - This mode allow to quick test the map.
	SETTINGS - Contain different options and controls (map title/save/sun control/quit button)
	SELECTION & EDIT - (*not available yet) Will be used to setup interactive object ID's and stuff such lights, lightswitches, objectives and more.
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_EditorTab.png

 Online map editing 
	Map Editor allow you to create maps online with other players, basically you can chose between 3 different server settings.
	 Private server : Select a password during the game creation phase, doing this you can avoid griefers. Give the password to your friends if you want them to join in.
	 Open Server with Spectating mode : Open server without password. turn OFF the spectator autojoin option inside the lobby options area. With this setup other players can spectate your game without editing and chat permission.
	 Open Server : Open server without password. Everyone can join your server with editing permission, be careful about griefers. If someone mess up your map just quit the editor without saving and change the server rules.

 New Class: Meat Zombie!  
	The Meat Zombie is a support class equipped with 2 healing abilities and one melee attack.
	http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MeatZombie.png
 Meat Zombie Stats

	 HP: 55
	 Movement Speed: 4.6
	 Melee damage: 25 hp
	 Melee Attack Speed: 0.3s
	 Healing touch: +10 hp
	 Healing touch speed: 0.45

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_BloodPool.png

Healing Spit
The Healing Spit ability creates a pool of curative blood that heals allies and enemies that pass through.


Type: AO heal
Healing power: +10 hps


http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_BloodPool.png

New Avatar
Meat Zombie avatar is now available as Avatar.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_MeatAvatar.png

 Level Cap upped to Level 40
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_74/OGAT_74_Levels.png

notes.notes:
Of Guards and Thieves 67.0 Update Overview  
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png 
  Changelog  
Here's the complete changelog for 67.0 update:
 
     New gamemode: gCTF (Guards only Capture The Flag)
     Dedicated Server support: in testing
     Server list: show icon and ping for dedicated servers
  Level cap moved to Level 25
  Arena map is now available for gTDM gamemode
  Bug fix: stepping over a grenade explosion now cause damage
 
  New gamemode: gCTF (Guards only Capture The Flag)  
As the name says, this is an alternative version of the classic CTF.

In this mode, there are two teams (Blue and Red), both have guards classes. 
At the start of this game, there will be 4 special "bases" that will be spawned 
onto the map. Your home flag location, your capture point, the enemy's flag location and finally the enemy's capture point. 
The objective in this mode is to bring the enemy's flag to your capture point while being able to defend your own flag from getting into the enemy's capture point. Learn the four "bases" locations for every map before playing! In this mode, knowledge of the map is essential. Knowing where the enemy is located and being able to quickly move past him via shortcuts can be the difference between winning and losing. It is a good idea to organize your teams into groups such as an attacking group and a defending group.
The match lasts five minutes in which the two teams will face each other to win the game. 

Dedicated Server support: in testing
Initial support for dedicated server, not officially released yet cause there is some bug to fix and stuff to improve.
You can still start to test them, at the moment there are four testing Eu-server and three testing US-server (unofficial).

Of Guards and Thieves 65.0 Update Overview  
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png 
  Changelog  
Here's the complete changelog for 65.0 update:
 
     Netcode rewrite and improvements
     New gamemode gTDM (Guards vs Guards TDM)
     New map VR Concrete Lake (for IG,igCTF, gTDM, MadBall)
  TeamSpeak server official launch (ts.ofguardsandthieves.com)
  Sandbox spoiler: Environment interaction and Night & Day cycle
 
  Netcode improvements  
Netcode has been improved, less lag, more fun.

New gamemode gTDM (Guards vs Guards TDM)
As the name says, this is an alternative version of the classic TDM.

In this mode, there are two teams (Red and Blue), both team have the guards classes (Scout/Assault/Medic/Guardian/Carrier). 
The first team to get to 20 kills is the winner. 
There is a time limit of 5 minutes which means that if neither teams reached a kill count of 20, the higher scorer will win. 
Preserve your health and your ammo to be able to maximize your kill count while minimizing the kill count of the opposite team. 
Remember, every time you get killed, you are giving one point away to the opposite team and vice-versa!
The match lasts five minutes in which the two teams will face each other to win the game. 

*At the moment the gTDM is available only on VR Maps but will be available soon in normal maps too.

notes.title: OGAT - Update 0.64 - Faceless GameMode and Horror Week!
notes.notes:
Of Guards and Thieves 64.0 Update Overview  
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/_CHARACTER_GROUPclean_01.png 
Hi guys,
Update 64 is available from October 30!

Here's the complete changelog for 64.0 update:
 
    New Gamemode: Faceless (SL) - Horror Fun gamemode
    Maximum number of lives is now configurable in server settings
    New Avatar: Faceless one, Human, Halloween pumpkin
    New game Main Menu
    New damage system (vfx feedback) v.1
    Scene loading improvements and Fix
    Halloween decorations
    BugFix: Character outline disappear in spectator mode 
    BugFix: No more button interaction when the 3 seconds countdown started
 

  New Gamemode: Faceless (SL)  
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_64.0/OGAT_64_SL_01.jpg 
In this new gamemode Humans have to find 4 notes around the map within 5 minutes, without being killed by the Faceless.
Faceless is a very dangerous enemy, can become invisible and suddenly appear behind you.
If you look them in the face too long, you will be wounded to death, be careful and run to survive!

Faceless have to kill the humans before they can pick up the 4 notes.
If time runs out humans lose.

Objectives and rules  
Human team:
Collect 4 notes before time runs out.

Faceless team:
Kill all the humans before time runs out.

HINT:  
* To collect Notes press the E key when you are close enough.
* Notes are placed randomly in each game, so you should check carefully for them in order to win the game.
* Every Player have different sheets position, everyone has to play for themselves.
* Some times sheets are not easy to spot, make sure to check carefully.
* Check all libraries and shelves!
* Humans do not have weapons to defend themselves, they have only one flashlight, so Faceless can not 'be killed in any way.
* When you meet a Faceless, RUN AWAY!!!

* Faceless can turn invisibility on/off with the Right Mouse Button.
* Faceless can use invisibility only when it is illuminated.
* Faceless can not cause damage or fear when it is invisible.

Balance suggestion: use 4:1 team ratio (4 Humans : 1 Faceless)

http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_64.0/OGAT_64_classes.png 
 Faceless One 
Health: 75
Base max speed: 3.0 (double when invisible)
-Scream attack
-Invisibility ability

  Invisiility Ability  
The Faceless one has the ability to become invisible.
Use the right mouse button to switch invisibility On/Off and keep in mind, when it is invisible can not 'cause harm to humans.


 Humans  
HP: 60
Base max speed: 4.4
-Flashlight

New Avatar  
Here the list of the new available Avatar:
- Faceless One
- Human
- Halloween pumpkin
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_64.0/OGAT_64_Avatarnew.png 

 Halloween decorations  
Just as the title,  decorations!
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_64.0/OGAT_64_deco_01.jpg 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_64.0/OGAT_64_deco_02.jpg 

  Limited lives system  
Server Admin can now set the number of lives available on each game.
This option is not available in certain gamemodes.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_64.0/OGAT_64_lives.jpg 

  Damage Feedback system v.1   
VFX damage feedback improvements:
- Camera shake
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_64.0/OGAT_64_damage.jpg 

 Scene loading improvements and Fix  
Scene loading system has been rewritten, that change brings several collateral bug fix and general improvements.


Thanks all for the support and see you in game!

* Notes are placed randomly in each game, so you should check carefully for them in order to win the game.
* Every Player have different sheets position, everyone has to play for themselves.
* Some times sheets are not easy to spot, make sure to check carefully.
* Check all libraries and shelves!
* Humans do not have weapons to defend themselves, they have only one flashlight, so Faceless can not 'be killed in any way.
* When you meet a Faceless, RUN AWAY!!!

* Faceless can turn invisibility on/off with the Right Mouse Button.
* Faceless can use invisibility only when it is illuminated.
* Faceless can not cause damage or fear when it is invisible.

The Fat zombie is an ibrid support-defensive class, its slow movements do not allow him to be very versatile in offensive maneuvers,
but his strength and his melee attacks damage make it very useful in defensive positions.
In addition, the puke ability allows him to block important spot, damaging his enemies and supporting the team maneuvers.
 Fat Stats  
Health: 80
Base max speed: 4

  Puke Ability  
The puke ability creates a pool of gastric juices that slow down movements and damage enemies that pass through.
*The puke pool also affects your teammates and yourself, so use it with care!

 Puke effects  
 
     Area Damage: 12 DPS
     Hit Damage: 30 
     Explosion Damage: 15
     Explosion range: 0.8 meters
     Slow down factor: 0.3
     Duration: 7 seconds
 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_63.0/OGAT_63_Puke.jpg 
New Avatar  
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_63.0/Avt_Fat_01.png 

  Ability Cooldown system  
Ability/equipment now have a cooldown timer, this means that you have to wait a certain period of time before being able to reuse that ability.
You can check the ability/equipment cooldown status on the right bottom section of the game screen.

 Here the list of the actual cooldown time:
- Acid spit: 4 seconds
- Puke: 4 seconds
- Smoke bomb: 7 seconds
- Rock Launcher: 3 seconds
- Railgun: 1.2 seconds

  New Gadget: Glue Bomb   
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_63.0/OGAT_63_Gluebomb.jpg 
The glue bomb is a grenade available for scout class, the explosion generates a puddle of glue that will slow down anyone moves over it.

 Glue Bomb effect  
 
     Slow down factor: 0.3
     Duration: 12 seconds
 

 SPOILER ABOUT SANDBOX MODES FEATURES  
*NOTE: All the contents below is not available yet.

 Crafting and Inventory  
Crafting will be one of the most 'important and rich aspect of this gamemode, our goal is to create a really deep and solid crafting and harvesting system with huge amounts of recipes and items combination.
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_63.0/OGAT_63_craftingsample.png 
*Crafting recipe sample: Empty magazine + 9mm bullets pack = Full magazine

To do that we need a solid inventory system, and this is our solution for that. 
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_63.0/OGAT_63_Inventory_01_SCALED.jpg 

 Farming  
If you like farming simulation games, prepare your shovel and fertilizer, you'll have hours and hours of farming!
http://www.helba.org/_OGAT/NEWS/News_63.0/OGAT_63_Sandbox_01_SCALED.jpg 

That's all! Just a little spoiler ;-)
If you want more details don't miss our future updates and check out our official forum.

Again, thanks all for the support and see you in game!

Hi guys,
Update 62 is available from September 3!

    New gamemode: Capture the Flag (CTF)
